unit.why: A legend about Elijah appearing at the circumcision of the Ari (R. Isaac Luria), quoted from Shivhei ha-Ari; the Ari is a pre-Hasidic kabbalist, so the story is not Hasidic.

stories.start_quote: ובס׳ נשבחי האר״י בהקדמה וז״ל רבינו
stories.end_quote: כי אור גדול יוצא ממנו לעולם
stories.summary_en: Elijah reveals himself to the Ari's father and tells him not to circumcise the child until Elijah stands beside him. At the circumcision the father waits more than half an hour despite the congregation's rebuke. Elijah then arrives, unseen by all but the father, holds the infant as sandak and declares that a great light will come from him.

tags.why: Praise of the Ari, copied from Shivhei ha-Ari
